Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the right lane of a residential road in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle ahead
slowed and Driver 1 applied the brakes. The vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's car, which was partly in the lane of
oncoming traffic, producing a low-speed head-on impact. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred just as described
by Driver 1, and two nearby witnesses gave consistent accounts of the sequence. Photographs taken at the scene
show damage to the front end of Driver 1's vehicle and the matching area on Driver 2's car, and the location of the
damage agrees with the reported impact. Officers confirmed that the Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time
of the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was transported for evaluation, and the reported injury
is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type. No prior damage to either vehicle was noted or reported.
Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy covering the vehicle.
